name: Stem Theory
description: Twin circular portraits hang from a sweeping forked stem beneath a large editorial heading; an open reading column follows.

name: Morello Index
description: An orchard archive card with a narrow numbered-edge motif, a raised name tab and a title between offset vertical rules.

name: Maraschino Club
description: A sharp nightlife composition with a capsule panorama, a bold condensed heading and an inset octagonal reading panel.

name: Griotte Duet
description: A title-led split header faces two stepped photographic windows, with a broad uninterrupted writing area underneath.

name: Stone & Velvet
description: A literary folio with a stepped double frame, oversized italic heading and a small pit-and-orbit emblem.

name: Cherrywire
description: A modern phone with a camera capsule, a round contact portrait, soft message tails and a slim composer.

name: Kirsch Key
description: A folding handset with a recessed conversation screen, a visible hinge and a compact three-column keypad.

name: Glacé Link
description: A landscape sliding communicator with paired contact windows and a full-width keyboard deck beneath its chat screen.

name: Sweet Frequency
description: A curved pocket music messenger with a square contact screen, compact messages and an engraved circular clickwheel.

name: Nightcherry
description: A small wrist communicator with a rounded watch case, ribbed straps, a side crown and stacked notifications.

name: Stipule
description: A miniature hanging orchard label, with a punched eyelet, a curved base and a small stem seal.

name: Pipmark
description: A compact asymmetric reply with a tiny round portrait tucked into a circular cutaway beside the heading.

name: Blushlet
description: A small open note with a broad horizontal title tab and two offset cherry-colour dots.

name: Twin Pits
description: A short reply beneath two interlocking portrait lenses and a centred name, with an oval member-colour frame.

name: Last Stone
description: A spare miniature page enclosed by opposing corner strokes, finished with a small oval pit mark.
